senses.gloss: m. pl. [or טַשְׁטְקִי f. sing.] (= תַּשְׁתְּ׳, שקי; cmp. טַצְיְּקָא) troughs, or bucket arrangement for pumping water for the boiler.
units: Nidd. 68ᵃ אטו … ט׳ חסרת וכ׳ Ar. (ed. omit אטו) doest thou want boilers? dost thou want buckets? dost thou want slaves? [Rashi: bathing chairs; Tosaf. to Nidd. 66ᵇ, a. v. אם, identifies our w. with טכטכא; Saadia: combs.]
